annotations.title: Healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and other Dutch benefits (toeslagen) estimate

description: Estimates which main Dutch household benefits are likely for 2026, from income, assets, rent and children's ages, with indicative yearly amounts. Read-only; it does not apply for anything, and the Belastingdienst decides eligibility. Covers healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag), rent allowance (huurtoeslag), child benefit (kinderbijslag), child budget (kindgebonden budget), the conditions for childcare allowance (kinderopvangtoeslag), the working-parent tax credit (IACK) and exemption from municipal taxes (kwijtschelding).

assets.description: Household savings and investments on 1 January. Default 0.

child_ages.description: Ages of children under 18 living with you, e.g. [2, 7]. Default none.

housing.description: Rent, own home, or other (e.g. living with parents). Default rent.

monthly_rent.description: Basic monthly rent (kale huur, without service costs). Needed for rent allowance.

partner_income.description: Partner's yearly gross income. Omit if you have no (benefits) partner.

partner_works.description: Partner has paid work. Default true.

uses_childcare.description: Uses registered daycare, a childminder or after-school care. Default false.

you_work.description: You have paid work. Default true.
